text: Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed. The requests stopped with the HTTP 502 error. A deploy caused this failure. The deploy removed the cache warmup step. At 14:27, we reverted the deploy. Then the error rate decreased. At 14:31, all requests operated correctly again. We are sorry for this problem. To prevent this problem again, we will make the cache warmup step a mandatory part of each deploy. We will also monitor the cache more closely.
